renamed.note: Shows the current time and writes it to the input.
`time` is a `Date` or `'now'`. `locales` has no effect and has no new name.
12h or 24h from the browser locale, with or without `defaultTime`.
Inverted. Smooth movement stays the default.
The object form also shows the Clear button.
One key for the caption, the accessible name and the announcement. An old key set next to it still wins for its own use.
Receives `{ type: 'AM' | 'PM' }`. The `select:am` and `select:pm` events become `select:period`.

removed.name: Old names of the options renamed in 4.5.0, for example `ui.mobile` and `labels.hourLabel`
removed.action: Use the new names. The [Renamed in 4.5.0](https://timepicker-ui.vercel.app/docs/api/options#renamed) table lists every pair.

removed.name: `select:am` and `select:pm` events, `callbacks.onSelectAM` and `callbacks.onSelectPM`
removed.action: Use `select:period` or `callbacks.onSelectPeriod`. The payload is `{ type: 'AM' | 'PM' }`.

removed.name: `update({ options, create }, callback)`
removed.action: Use `setOptions(options)`. If you passed `create: true`, call `picker.create()` after it. Code from the callback can run on the next line.

removed.name: `clock.currentTime.locales`
removed.action: Remove it. It has no effect since 4.5.0, because the library formats the value itself.

removed.name: `getValue().degreesHours`, `getValue().degreesMinutes`
removed.action: Stop reading them. They are internal clock angles.

removed.name: `labels.format24Label`
removed.action: Remove it. It has no effect.

removed.name: `focusInputAfterCloseModal` (legacy option)
removed.action: Use `behavior.returnFocus`. It defaults to `false`; 5.0 makes `true` the default.

removed.name: `hide` event and `HideEventData`
removed.action: Remove listeners for it. The picker never emits `hide`.

removed.name: `range:get-disabled-time` and `range:update-disabled` events
removed.action: Remove listeners for them. The picker never emits them.

removed.name: `ErrorEventData.rejectedHour`, `ErrorEventData.rejectedMinute`
removed.action: Stop reading them. They are always `undefined`.
